text:
tyler_cs: Hey team — FinBank sent an evidence request. They want: SBOM, KMS access audit for keys used by private deployments, and ETA for remediation of CVE-2025-0456 (openssl libcrypto). Can we confirm what we can provide and timeline?

jess_sec: Filing here. We have SBOMs per release but need to confirm customer-scoped package. I can produce a CycloneDX SBOM for the runtime image. ETA: EOD tomorrow if no blockers. :hourglass: 

mark_sre: CVE-2025-0456 — quick summary: affects libcrypto <=2.1.3 with TLS session state leak on specific ciphers. We rolled a patched runtime 2025-03-02 for hosted; dedicated pools were patched via rolling update last week. Private customers: depends on whether they're on auto-updates.

lina_sec: Good catch. @mark_sre can you list which clusters still report vulnerable libcrypto versions? We should prioritize any FedRAMP/SOC2 customers.

mark_sre: Running a quick query now: `select cluster, image_tag from deployments where library like '%libcrypto%2.1.3%'` — rough results show 3 private clusters on older images (customer: FinBank, AlphaRetail, test-qa). Will open a ticket.

security-bot: Import: CVE-2025-0456 detected in dependency tree for repo `inference-runtime` — severity: High; public exploit: No; published: 2025-03-01.

jess_sec: For the SBOM: I can run `cyclonedx-cli -i images/runtime:sha -o sbom-finbank.json` and upload to compliance bucket. Where should we put customer-specific evidence?

tyler_cs: Please upload to `s3://redwood-compliance/finbank/` and cc me. FinBank also asked for KMS access logs showing who/when keys were used to decrypt model artifacts. Do we have a query for KMS logs?

lina_sec: We retain CloudKMS logs in CloudTrail for 365 days. For hosted keys we can pull audit trails; for private deployments using customer-managed keys, we only hold metadata (audit logs live in their cloud). We need to be explicit to FinBank: we can provide logs for keys managed by Redwood; for customer-managed keys we can provide guidance and an example query for them to run.

mark_sre: For Redwood-managed keys, I can extract a minimal timeline: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=crypto_key && protoPayload.methodName=\"Encrypt\"" --limit 1000` — we'll filter to key ring and time range. I can deliver a proof bundle with redacted requester identities. ETA: 24 hours.

jess_sec: SBOM task created: COMPL-481. Upload path: `s3://redwood-compliance/finbank/sbom-runtime-20250305.json` (will update when done).

lina_sec: Remediation plan for CVE: 1) Host: already patched. 2) Dedicated: patched for most pools; will patch remaining within 48 hours. 3) Private: notify customers with instruction + patch package. For customers on auto-update we push patch; for manual customers we provide SR with patch bundle.

tyler_cs: FinBank wants an ETA for full remediation and whether we recommend key rotation. Can you confirm recommended guidance on KMS key rotation?

jess_sec: Recommend rotation if keys have been used by vulnerable runtime prior to patch — low-cost precaution. For Redwood-managed keys we can rotate and provide evidence of new key usage. For customer-managed keys, ask them to rotate and we can provide a template playbook.

mark_sre: I'll add a checklist to the ticket: patch rollout windows, regression test steps, and post-patch smoke tests (token generation + TLS handshake checks). Estimated full remediation ETA: 48 hours for hosted+deds, 72 hours for private customers with assistance.

security-bot: Action required: Create AO ticket for FinBank evidence package -> assign to @jess_sec + @mark_sre + @tyler_cs.

tyler_cs: Thanks. I'll reply to FinBank with: SBOM (attached once ready), KMS audit for Redwood-managed keys (we can provide), guidance for customer-managed keys, and remediation ETA (48-72h). I'll include the playbook and rotation recommendation.

jess_sec: Uploaded provisional SBOM to the compliance bucket and started redaction pass. Link: `s3://redwood-compliance/finbank/sbom-runtime-20250305.json` — sending to FinBank in 30m.

lina_sec: I’ll draft the KMS audit extract and a short FAQ about what we can/cannot provide for private keys. Will post draft here for review.

mark_sre: Started the non-blocking patch job for the 3 private clusters; will update ticket with patch IDs.

tyler_cs: Perfect. Once we have the SBOM + KMS extract + remediation timeline I’ll send to the customer and mark SOC2 evidence status. :thumbsup:
